entities.name: Gustaf Fröding
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Gustaf Fröding was a Swedish poet and writer from Alster, Värmland. The family moved to Kristinehamn in the year 1867. He later studied at Uppsala University and worked as a journalist in Karlstad.
